paired_bootstrap: Whole source groups resampled within origin, identical draws for baseline/variant; fits/thresholds fixed. Silhouette CI resamples cached per-artwork scores conditional on fixed geometry, without recomputing pairwise distances.
control_ablation: Full185015 native metadata contrasts retained. Pixel mixed-origin experiment uses pre-frozen balanced45000 tier2 cohort, not all185015; SD resized256 and source composition differs, so differences cannot isolate resolution alone.
full_canvas: Single full256 feature vector (no across-crop IQR duplicates), versus four/five crop aggregation; dimension differs and is reported.
border: No refit or new hypothesis decisions after inspection; directional sensitivity only, zero confirmatory conclusions in either condition.
kmeans: NumPy Lloyd k2, 20 seeded k-means++ starts, max300 iterations; sklearn native KMeans DLL blocked by Windows Application Control.
runtime_scope: Successful invocation including cache loading; completed batches may come from earlier invocation(s). This is not a reconstruction of total experiment wall time.
